title: President Order 3 High Court Judges Travelling Allowance Amendment Order 2002

sections.shortTitle: President Order 3 High Court Judges Travelling Allowance Amendment Order 2002
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement.

President Order 3 of 2002, High Court Judges (Travelling Allowance)
(Amendment) Order 2002
President Order 3 of 2002, High
Court Judges (Travelling Allowance) (Amendment) Order 2002
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 4th April, 2002]
F.No.2(2)/2002-Pub., dated 4‑4‑2002.‑‑The
following Order promulgated by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Order may be called the High Court
Judges (Travelling Allowance) (Amendment) Order, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the first day of December,
2001.

following Order promulgated by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
2. Amendment of paragraph II,
P.O. No.4 of 1965.‑‑In the said Order, in paragraph II, in sub‑paragraph
(1),‑‑
(a) for the words "three
hundred and eighty" the words "four hundred and ninety" shall be
substituted; and
(b) in the proviso, for the words
"four hundred and forty" the words (six hundred and five shall be
substituted.
